the strategic marketing of organizations and the marketing strategy of organizations, which we define as an organization’s pattern of choices concerning its marketing activities, marketing resources and the creation, communication, and/or delivery of its products that offer value in exchanges with customers and thereby enables the achievement of the organization’s specific objectives.

In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

marketing strategy is an organization’s integrated and coordinated pattern of decision, consisting of the organization’s marketing objectives, and the policies and programs designed to achieve these objectives and support and integrate with other business strategies.

strategic marketing as a distinct field of study encompasses the study of organizational and inter-organizational phenomena in the marketplace in the context of value creation, communication and distribution, with a view to understanding and explaining the general management responsibilities of the marketing function and its role in the creation of competitive advantages for organizations.
strategic marketing is concerned with the study of the general management responsibilities of the marketing function, and the study of the marketing strategy of the business.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the field of marketing strategy is a multidisciplinary field that studies the strategic management of marketing in business organizations and the strategic marketing of products in business markets.
marketing strategy can be viewed as an organization’s pattern of decisions and actions concerning the products it offers, the markets it serves, its marketing activities and its marketing resources.

marketing strategy is an organization’s integrated patterns of decisions that specify crucial choices concerning products, markets, marketing activities and marketing resource s that enable it to achieve its objectives.
The main takeaway from our work is that
strategic marketing is a domain of study with its own unique set of phenomena, and that it should be distinguished from marketing management as well as other fields of study in management.
marketing strategy can be viewed as a general management strategy and as a functional strategy, depending on the level at which the organization operates.

marketing strategy can be usefully viewed as a subset of the more general construct of business strategy, with the latter being defined as the integrated pattern of decisions specifying the crucial choices concerning the products, markets and activities of an organization and its resources that enable the organization to achieve its objectives in its interactions with its environment.
